10. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((5,8)\) and \((11,4)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(A B\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) It is given that the equation of a circle \(C\) is \(x^{2}+y^{2}-18 x-9 y=0\). Someone claims that \(\Gamma\) divides \(C\) into two equal halves. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
10. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((5,8)\) 和 \((11,4)\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A\)、\(B\) 等距，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(b) 已知圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2-18x-9y=0\)。有人聲稱 \(\Gamma\) 把 \(C\) 分成兩個相等部分。判斷聲稱是否正確並解釋。
questions.hint: Line bisects circle area only if through centre. Substitute centre into Γ.
questions.hintZh: 直線平分圓面積必過圓心。代入中心。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AB\).
(ii) Put \(P=(x,y)\). Equating the squared distances gives

\[
(x-5)^2+(y-8)^2=(x-11)^2+(y-4)^2.
\]

Simplifying gives \(12x-8y-48=0\), hence \(\Gamma:3x-2y-12=0\).
(b) The circle stated in the question has centre \((9,\frac92)\). Substitution gives

\[
3(9)-2\left(\frac92\right)-12=6\ne0.
\]

The centre does not lie on \(\Gamma\). A line bisects the area of a circle only when it passes through its centre. Therefore the claim is incorrect.
questions.solutionZh:
答案：
(a)(i) \(\Gamma\) 是線段 \(AB\) 的垂直平分線。
(a)(ii) 由 \(PA=PB\) 得 \(3x-2y-12=0\)。
(b) 圓 \(C\) 的圓心為 \((9,\frac92)\)。代入 \(\Gamma\) 得 \(3(9)-2(\frac92)-12=6\ne0\)，所以圓心不在 \(\Gamma\) 上。只有通過圓心的直線才會把圓分成兩個等面積部分，因此聲稱不正確。

questions.stem:
14. The circle \(C\) passes through the point \(A(-2,8)\), and the centre of \(C\) is the point \(G(3,-4)\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) It is given that the equation of the straight line \(L_1\) is
\[
17x+7y+5=0.
\]Another straight line \(L_2\) is parallel to \(L_1\). It is given that \(L_2\) cuts \(C\) at two distinct points \(Q\) and \(R\). \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(QP=RP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(QR\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Suppose that \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(S\) and \(T\). Find the ratio of the area of \(\triangle SQT\) to the area of \(\triangle SRT\).
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A(-2,8)\)，圓心為 \(G(3,-4)\)。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 直線 \(L_1\) 的方程為 \(17x+7y+5=0\)。另一條直線 \(L_2\) 與 \(L_1\) 平行，並與 \(C\) 交於兩個不同點 \(Q,R\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(QP=RP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(QR\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(iii) 若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(S,T\)，求 \(\triangle SQT\) 與 \(\triangle SRT\) 的面積比。（8 分）
questions.hint: Chord perpendicular bisector passes through centre. Parallel chord → perpendicular bisector perpendicular to chord.
questions.hintZh: 弦垂直平分線過圓心。平行弦 → 平分線垂直弦。
questions.solution:
(a) \(AG^2=(-2-3)^2+(8+4)^2=169\), so \(C:(x-3)^2+(y+4)^2=169\).

(b)(i) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(QR\).

(ii) The chord is parallel to \(L_1\), with slope \(-\frac{17}{7}\). Thus \(\Gamma\) has slope \(\frac7{17}\) and passes through the centre \(G\). Hence \(y+4=\frac7{17}(x-3)\), or \(7x-17y-89=0\).

(iii) \(Q,R\) are reflections in \(\Gamma\), which contains \(ST\). The triangles have the same base \(ST\) and equal heights. Their area ratio is \(1:1\).

questions.stem:
13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-7,26)\) and \((-7,-14)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that \(G\) lies in quadrant I and the radius of \(C\) is \(25\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) Let \(L\) be the straight line passing through \(G\) and the origin \(O\). \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\) is \(k\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that \(\Gamma\) passes through the point \((0,-25)\).
(i) Find \(k\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(S,T,U\) and \(V\). Find the area of the quadrilateral formed by \(S,T,U\) and \(V\).
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(A(-7,26)\) 和 \(B(-7,-14)\) 為一個半徑為 \(25\) 的圓上的兩點，圓心位於第一象限。
(a) 求該圓的方程。
(b) 直線 \(L\) 經過 \(G\) 及原點。動點 \(P\) 到 \(L\) 的距離為 \(k\)。軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 經過 \((0,-25)\)，求 \(k\) 及 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(c) \(\Gamma\) 與該圓相交於 \(S,T,U,V\)。求四邊形 \(STUV\) 的面積。
questions.hint: A,B same x → bisector horizontal. Parallel chords cut by circle form rectangle.
questions.hintZh: A,B 同 x → 平分線水平。平行弦成矩形。
questions.solution:
13.

(a) Since \(A\) and \(B\) have the same \(x\)-coordinate, the \(y\)-coordinate of \(G\) is

\[
\frac{26+(-14)}2=6.
\]

Let \(G=(g,6)\). Since the radius is \(25\),

\[
(g+7)^2+(6-26)^2=25^2.
\]

Thus

\[
(g+7)^2=225,
\]

so

\[
g=8\quad \text{or}\quad g=-22.
\]

Since \(G\) lies in quadrant I,

\[
G=(8,6).
\]

Therefore, the equation of \(C\) is

\[
(x-8)^2+(y-6)^2=625.
\]

(b)(i) The equation of \(L\), which passes through \(O\) and \(G(8,6)\), is

\[
3x-4y=0.
\]

The distance from \((0,-25)\) to \(L\) is

\[
\frac{|3(0)-4(-25)|}{\sqrt{3^2+(-4)^2}}=\frac{100}{5}=20.
\]

Therefore,

\[
k=20.
\]

(b)(ii) The locus \(\Gamma\) consists of the two lines parallel to \(L\) at distance \(20\):

\[
3x-4y=100,\qquad 3x-4y=-100.
\]

The distance from \(G(8,6)\) to each of these lines is \(20\). Hence each chord cut from circle \(C\) has length

\[
2\sqrt{25^2-20^2}=30.
\]

The distance between the two parallel lines is

\[
\frac{200}{\sqrt{3^2+(-4)^2}}=40.
\]

Thus the quadrilateral formed by \(S,T,U,V\) is a rectangle with area

\[
30(40)=1200.
\]

questions.stem:
14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-5,-6)\) and \((1,12)\) respectively. The circle \(C\) passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). It is given that the \(y\)-coordinate of \(G\) is \(2\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) The straight line \(\ell\) passes through \(A\) and \(G\). Another straight line \(L\) passes through \(B\) and is parallel to \(\ell\). Let \(P\) be a moving point on the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(\ell\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(L\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Let \(Q\) and \(R\) be the points of intersection of \(\Gamma\) and \(C\), where the \(y\)-coordinate of \(Q\) is greater than that of \(R\). Find \(\angle BQA\).
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A=(-5,-6)\)、\(B=(1,12)\)，圓心 \(G\) 的 \(y\) 坐標為 \(2\)。
(a) 求圓方程。
(b) 直線 \(\ell\) 經過 \(A,G\)；直線 \(L\) 經過 \(B\) 且平行於 \(\ell\)。動點 \(P\) 到 \(L,\ell\) 的垂直距離相等，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L\) 的關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。
(iii) \(\Gamma\) 與圓交於 \(Q,R\)，其中 \(Q\) 的 \(y\) 坐標較大。求 \(\angle BQA\)。（9 分）
questions.hint: Equal radii. Middle parallel line. Cosine rule for central angle.
questions.hintZh: 等半徑。中間平行線。餘弦定理求圓心角。
questions.solution:
(a) Put \(G=(g,2)\). Equal radii give \((g+5)^2+64=(g-1)^2+100\), hence g=1 and radius 10. Thus \(C:(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=100\).
(b)(i) The equal-distance midline Gamma is parallel to L.
(ii) \(\ell:4x-3y+2=0\) and \(L:4x-3y+32=0\), so their midline is \(\Gamma:4x-3y+17=0\).
(iii) \(GA=GB=10\) and \(AB^2=360\). The cosine rule gives \(\cos\angle AGB=(200-360)/200=-4/5\). The higher intersection Q lies on the major arc AB, so
\[\angle BQA=\tfrac12\cos^{-1}(-4/5)\approx71.565^\circ.\]

questions.stem:
Let O be the origin. The line is \(y=m^2x\), where \(m\ne0\).
(a) A and B lie on the positive x-axis and positive y-axis respectively. A has x-coordinate a. The horizontal line through B meets \(y=m^2x\) at C, where AB = AC. ABDC is a rhombus. Express its area in terms of a and m.
(b) E = (128,72) and F = (128,0). EF meets the line at S. U lies on the positive y-axis and US is horizontal, on line L. T lies on the positive x-axis and V in the first quadrant; STUV is a rhombus of area 2304 square units.
(i) Find L.
(ii) P is equidistant from T and L. Find the equation of its locus.
questions.stemZh:
14. \(O\) 為原點，題設直線為 \(y=m^2x\)。
(a) \(A,B\) 分別在正 \(x\) 軸、正 \(y\) 軸上，\(A\) 的 \(x\) 坐標為 \(a\)。過 \(B\) 的水平線與 \(y=m^2x\) 交於 \(C\)，且 \(AB=AC\)，\(m\ne0\)。\(ABDC\) 是菱形，以 \(a,m\) 表示其面積。（3 分）
(b) \(E=(128,72)\)、\(F=(128,0)\)。\(EF\) 與該直線交於 \(S\)；\(U\) 在正 \(y\) 軸上，\(US\) 水平，所在直線為 \(L\)。\(T\) 在正 \(x\) 軸上，\(V\) 在第一象限，\(STUV\) 是面積 \(2304\) 的菱形。
(i) 求 \(L\)；(ii) 動點 \(P\) 與點 \(T\) 及直線 \(L\) 等距，求軌跡方程。（5 分）
questions.hint: Parameterise coordinates. Area = diagonal product /2.
questions.hintZh: 坐標參數化。面積 = 對角線積 /2。
questions.solution:
(a) Write B = (0,b) and C = (c,b), with c > 0. From AB = AC, \(a^2+b^2=(c-a)^2+b^2\), giving c = 2a. Thus \(b=2m^2a\) and \(D=(a,4m^2a)\). The perpendicular diagonals BC and AD have lengths \(2a\) and \(4m^2a\), so the area is \(4m^2a^2\).
(b)(i) If S = (128,s), then U = (0,s). The other diagonal of the rhombus is vertical through x = 64; T = (64,0), V = (64,2s). Thus \(128(2s)/2=2304\), giving s = 18 and L: y = 18.
(ii) Equal squared distances give \((x-64)^2+y^2=(y-18)^2\), or \(x^2-128x+36y+3772=0\).

questions.stem:
14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((0,-8)\) and \((12,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (2 marks)
(b) The equation of a circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+(6k+18)x-(4k+2)y+85-12k=0,
\]where \(k\) is a constant. It is known that \(\Gamma\) divides \(C\) into two equal parts.
(i) Find the centre \(G\) of the circle \(C\).
(ii) Prove that the circle touches the \(y\)-axis at a point \(D\).
(iii) Find the area of the quadrilateral \(ABGD\). (6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A=(0,-8)\)、\(B=(12,0)\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A,B\) 等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（2 分）
(b) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2+(6k+18)x-(4k+2)y+85-12k=0\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。\(\Gamma\) 把圓分成兩個相等部分。
(i) 求圓心 \(G\)；(ii) 證明圓與 \(y\) 軸相切於 \(D\)；(iii) 求四邊形 \(ABGD\) 面積。（6 分）
questions.hint: Centre on Γ. Radius = distance to y-axis → tangent. Trapezium area.
questions.hintZh: 中心在 Γ 上。半徑 = 到 y 軸距離 → 相切。梯形面積。
questions.solution:
(a) Expanding PA=PB after squaring gives \(\Gamma:3x+2y-10=0\).
(b)(i) The centre is \(G=(-3k-9,2k+1)\). Since Gamma bisects the circle into equal parts, it passes through G. Substitution gives \(-5k-35=0\), so \(k=-7,G=(12,-13)\).
(ii) Completing the square gives \((x-12)^2+(y+13)^2=144\). The radius 12 equals the centre's distance from the y-axis, so it touches that axis at \(D=(0,-13)\).
(iii) AD and BG are parallel, of lengths 5 and 13, and their separation is 12. Hence \([ABGD]=\tfrac12(5+13)(12)=108\).

questions.stem: 14. \(A(5,-1)\) and \(B(-3,5)\) are two points in a rectangular coordinate plane. (a) A moving point \(P_1(x,y)\) moves such that \(AP_1=BP_1\). Denote its locus by \(\Gamma_1\). (i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma_1\) and \(AB\). (ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma_1\). (b) Another moving point \(P_2(x,y)\) moves such that \(AP_2\) and \(BP_2\) are perpendicular. Denote its locus by \(\Gamma_2\). Find the equation of \(\Gamma_2\). (c) Suppose the equation of a circle \(C\) is \(x^2+y^2+(4k-14)x-(3k+20)y+124=0\). (i) Find \(k\) such that the centre of \(C\) lies on \(\Gamma_1\). (ii) Someone claims that there are no points of intersection between \(C\) and \(\Gamma_2\) for all real values of \(k\). Do you agree? Explain. (10 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A=(5,-1)\)、\(B=(-3,5)\)。
(a) 動點 \(P_1\) 滿足 \(AP_1=BP_1\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma_1\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma_1\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(\Gamma_1\) 方程。
(b) 動點 \(P_2\) 滿足 \(AP_2\perp BP_2\)，求其軌跡 \(\Gamma_2\) 方程。
(c) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2+(4k-14)x-(3k+20)y+124=0\)。
(i) 求使圓心在 \(\Gamma_1\) 上的 \(k\)。
(ii) 有人聲稱所有實數 \(k\) 均令 \(C\) 與 \(\Gamma_2\) 沒有交點。你是否同意？解釋。（10 分）
questions.hint: Thales theorem: right angle → circle on diameter. Counterexample for universal claim.
questions.hintZh: 泰勒斯定理：直角 → 直徑圓。反例推翻。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) Gamma1 is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
(ii) The midpoint is \((1,2)\) and the slope of AB is -3/4, giving \(\Gamma_1:4x-3y+2=0\).
(b) The right-angle locus is the diameter circle \(\Gamma_2:(x-1)^2+(y-2)^2=25\), excluding A and B because the angle there is undefined.
(c)(i) The centre of C is \((7-2k,(3k+20)/2)\). Substituting into Gamma1 gives \(-25k/2=0\), hence k=0.
(ii) At k=0, C has centre \((7,10)\) and radius 5. Its centre is distance 10 from \((1,2)\), so the two radius-5 circles touch externally at \((4,6)\). This point is not an excluded endpoint. Therefore the universal no-intersection claim is false.

questions.stem:
14. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-1,-1)\) and \((5,7)\) respectively.
(a) Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=BP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(AB\).
(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(iii) Suppose that \(G\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\). Denote the \(x\)-coordinate of \(G\) by \(h\). Let \(C\) be the circle which is centred at \(G\) and passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Prove that the equation of \(C\) is
\[
2x^2+2y^2-4hx+(3h-18)y-h-22=0.
\](6 marks)
(b) The coordinates of the point \(D\) are \((-23,21)\). Using (a)(iii), find the area of the circle which passes through \(A\), \(B\) and \(D\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A=(-1,-1)\)、\(B=(5,7)\)。
(a) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=BP\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係；(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程；
(iii) 圓心 \(G\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上，其 \(x\) 坐標為 \(h\)。以 \(G\) 為圓心的圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A,B\)。證明其方程為 \(2x^2+2y^2-4hx+(3h-18)y-h-22=0\)。（6 分）
(b) \(D=(-23,21)\)。利用 (a)(iii)，求經過 \(A,B,D\) 的圓面積，以 \(\pi\) 表示。（3 分）
questions.hint: Perpendicular bisector. Substitute D to find h. Area = πr².
questions.hintZh: 垂直平分線。代入 D 求 h。面積 = πr²。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) Gamma is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
(ii) The midpoint is \((2,3)\), so \(\Gamma:3x+4y-18=0\).
(iii) Thus \(G=(h,(18-3h)/4)\). Put \(g=(18-3h)/4\). The circle through A=(-1,-1) is
\[(x-h)^2+(y-g)^2=(h+1)^2+(g+1)^2.\]
Expanding, substituting g and multiplying by 2 gives
\[2x^2+2y^2-4hx+(3h-18)y-h-22=0.\]
(b) Substitution of D=(-23,21) gives \(154h+1540=0\), hence \(h=-10,G=(-10,12)\). The squared radius is \(GA^2=9^2+13^2=250\), so the circle area is \(250\pi\).

13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-9, 7)\) and \((-15, -1)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(PA = PB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(AB\). (1 mark)
(b) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (2 marks)
(c) \(\Gamma\) intersects the \(x\)-axis and the \(y\)-axis at \(M\) and \(N\) respectively. Denote the origin by \(O\). The circle \(C\) passes through \(O\), \(M\) and \(N\). Let \(Q\) be a moving point on \(C\). Find the greatest area of \(\triangle MNQ\). (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(A=(-9,7)\)、\(B=(-15,-1)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的關係。（1 分）
(b) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（2 分）
(c) \(\Gamma\) 分別與兩坐標軸交於 \(M,N\)。圓 \(C\) 經過原點 \(O\)、\(M,N\)。\(Q\) 在 \(C\) 上移動，求三角形 \(MNQ\) 最大面積。（4 分）
questions.hint: Perpendicular bisector. MN diameter, max height = radius.
questions.hintZh: 垂直平分線。MN 直徑，最大高 = 半徑。
questions.solution:
(a) Gamma is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
(b) From \((x+9)^2+(y-7)^2=(x+15)^2+(y+1)^2\), obtain \(\Gamma:3x+4y+24=0\).
(c) The intercepts are \(M=(-8,0),N=(0,-6)\), with MN=10. Since \(\angle MON=90^\circ\), MN is a diameter, and the circle radius is 5. The greatest height above a diameter is its radius, so
\[[MNQ]_{\max}=\tfrac12(10)(5)=25.\]

questions.stem:
13. The straight line L cuts the positive x-axis and the negative y-axis at the points A and B respectively. Let P be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(PA=PB\). Denote the locus of P by \(\Gamma\). It is given that the equation of \(\Gamma\) is
\[
4x+10y+21=0.
\](a) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment AB. (1 mark)
(b) Find the equation of L. (3 marks)
(c) Suppose that \(\Gamma\) cuts L and the y-axis at the points S and T respectively. Find the area of the quadrilateral OAST, where O is the origin. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 直線 \(L\) 分別與正 \(x\) 軸、負 \(y\) 軸交於 \(A,B\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(PA=PB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma:4x+10y+21=0\)。
(a) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(AB\) 的關係。（1 分）
(b) 求 \(L\) 方程。（3 分）
(c) \(\Gamma\) 分別與 \(L\)、\(y\) 軸交於 \(S,T\)。求四邊形 \(OAST\) 面積，\(O\) 為原點。（3 分）
questions.hint: Midpoint + slope. Split area along OS.
questions.hintZh: 中點 + 斜率。沿 OS 分割面積。
questions.solution:
(a) The locus is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
(b) Let \(A=(a,0)\), \(B=(0,b)\), with \(a>0,b<0\). The normal to the bisector is parallel to AB, so \(b=-5a/2\). Its midpoint satisfies \(2a+5b+21=0\). Thus \(a=2,b=-5\), and the required intercept line is
\[L:\frac{x}{2}-\frac{y}{5}=1,\quad 5x-2y-10=0.\]
Check both intercepts: A=(2,0) and B=(0,-5) satisfy it. The plus sign in the former solution was incorrect.
(c) Solving L with the bisector gives \(S=(1,-5/2)\), while \(T=(0,-21/10)\). Divide the quadrilateral along OS:
\[[OAST]=\tfrac12(2)(5/2)+\tfrac12(21/10)(1)=\tfrac{71}{20}.\]
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 軌跡是 AB 的垂直平分線。
(b) 設 \(A=(a,0)\)、\(B=(0,b)\)，其中 \(a>0,b<0\)。由垂直平分線的法向量與 AB 平行，得 \(b=-5a/2\)；其中點條件為 \(2a+5b+21=0\)。聯立得 \(a=2,b=-5\)，因此

代入 A=(2,0)、B=(0,-5) 均成立；舊版直線方程的 y 項正號不正確。
(c) 聯立兩直線得 \(S=(1,-5/2)\)，而 \(T=(0,-21/10)\)。沿 OS 分成兩三角形：
\[[OAST]=\tfrac12(2)(5/2)+\tfrac12(21/10)(1)=\tfrac{71}{20}.\]

questions.stemZh:

questions.hint: Circle equation. Perpendicular bisector through centre.
questions.hintZh: 圓方程。垂直平分線過圓心。
questions.solution:

(b)(i) For distinct A and B, Gamma is their perpendicular bisector. The specified straight-line locus excludes the coincident-endpoint case.
(ii) A chord's perpendicular bisector passes through the centre Q=(-3,8), so \(4(-3)+3(8)+k=0\). Therefore \(k=-12\).

(a) Find the locus of \(P\). (3 marks)
(b) A circle passes through \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the centre of the circle by \(X\) and its \(x\)-coordinate by \(q\).
(i) Express the coordinates of \(X\) in terms of \(q\).
(ii) It is given that \(X\) lies on the locus of \(P\) and \(AX\perp XB\). Find the possible coordinates of the centre of the circle. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. \(A=(8,-6)\)、\(B=(-4,10)\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩點等距。
(a) 求軌跡。（3 分）
(b) 圓經過 \(A,B\)，圓心為 \(X\)，其 \(x\) 坐標為 \(q\)。
(i) 以 \(q\) 表示 \(X\)；(ii) 已知 \(X\) 在軌跡上且 \(AX\perp XB\)，求所有可能圓心。（4 分）
questions.hint: Substitute X into bisector. Diameter circle intersection.
questions.hintZh: X 代入平分線。直徑圓交點。
questions.solution:
(a) The midpoint of AB is \((2,2)\) and its slope is -4/3. Therefore the perpendicular bisector is \(3x-4y+2=0\).
(b)(i) Its points have coordinates \(X=(q,(3q+2)/4)\).
(ii) Since AX is perpendicular to XB, X also lies on the circle with diameter AB:
\[(q-2)^2+((3q+2)/4-2)^2=100.\]
Thus \(25(q-2)^2=1600\), so \(q=-6\) or 10. Both satisfy the original conditions, giving centres \((-6,-4)\) and \((10,8)\).

(a) Find \(f(2)\). (3 marks)
(b) \(H(2,h)\) and \(K(6,k)\) are points lying on the graph of \(y=f(x)\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(H\) and \(K\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).

(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (3 marks)

(a) \(f(2)=15(2)-2(2)^2=22\).

(ii) \(H=(2,22),K=(6,18)\). Their midpoint is \((4,20)\) and their slope is -1, so the bisector is \(y-20=x-4\), or \(x-y+16=0\).

\(O=(0,0),A=(-40,0),B=(0,30)\)。圓 \(C\) 經過三點，圓心為 \(G\)。
(a) 求圓方程。
(b) \(L_1\) 經過 \(B,G\)；\(L_2\) 經過 \(O\) 並與 \(L_1\) 垂直交於 \(H\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(AP=PH\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。

(a) Find the equation of \(C\). (2 marks)
(b) Lines \(L_1,L_2\) intersect at \(A\). A moving point \(P\) is equidistant from them; denote its locus by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma,L_1,L_2\).
(ii) \(L_1\) intersects \(C\) at \(A,D\), where \(AD=12\). \(L_2\) intersects \(C\) at \(A,E\). The slope of \(L_1\) is positive and \(L_2:y=3\). Someone claims that \(B\) lies on \(\Gamma\). Do you agree? Explain. (6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(A(0,3)\) 和 \(B(12,9)\) 在圓 \(C\) 上，且 \(AB\) 是 \(C\) 的直徑。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。（2 分）
(b) 直線 \(L_1,L_2\) 相交於 \(A\)。動點 \(P\) 與兩直線等距，其軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma,L_1,L_2\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) \(L_1\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,D\)，且 \(AD=12\)；\(L_2\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,E\)。\(L_1\) 的斜率為正，且 \(L_2:y=3\)。有人聲稱 \(B\) 在 \(\Gamma\) 上。你是否同意？解釋答案。（6 分）
questions.hint: Angle bisectors are equidistant from two lines. Substitute D into circle.
questions.hintZh: 角平分線 = 到兩線等距。代入 D 入圓。
questions.solution:
(a) The diameter midpoint is \((6,6)\) and the squared radius is \(45\). Thus \(C:(x-6)^2+(y-6)^2=45\).
(b)(i) \(\Gamma\) consists of both angle bisectors of \(L_1,L_2\).
(ii) Let the positive slope be \(m\) and put \(D=A+t(1,m)\). Substitution into the circle gives the nonzero root \(t=(12+6m)/(1+m^2)\). Hence

\[
AD=\frac{12+6m}{\sqrt{1+m^2}}=12.
\]

Squaring gives \(m(3m-4)=0\). Since \(m>0\), \(m=4/3\) and \(L_1:4x-3y+9=0\).
The distance from \(B\) to \(L_1\) is \(|48-27+9|/5=6\); its distance to \(L_2\) is \(|9-3|=6\). Therefore \(B\) lies on \(\Gamma\). Agree.

14. \(L_1:3x+2y-5=0\)、\(L_2:3x+2y+7=0\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩線的垂直距離相等，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。

(b) \(Q=(9,12)\)，\(R\) 為 \(\Gamma\) 上與 \(Q\) 最近的點。
(i) 求 \(R\) 坐標。
(ii) 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2-2x+4y-164=0\) 的圓心為 \(G\)。直線 \(QR\) 與圓交於 \(W,S\)，\(\Gamma\) 與圓交於 \(T,U\)。有人聲稱 \([WTU]:[GRS]=7:2\)。聲稱是否正確？解釋。（9 分）
questions.hint: Middle parallel. Perpendicular foot. Compare areas.
questions.hintZh: 中間平行。垂直垂足。比較面積。
questions.solution:
(a) Equidistance from the parallel lines gives \(3x+2y+1=0\).
(b)(i) The perpendicular through \(Q=(9,12)\) is \(2x-3y+18=0\). Solving gives \(R=(-3,4)\).
(ii) Completing the square gives \(G=(1,-2)\) and radius \(13\). Since G lies on the locus, \(TU=26\). Also \(GR=2\sqrt{13}\). Because \(GR\perp QR\), R bisects chord WS, so \(RW=RS=\sqrt{169-52}=3\sqrt{13}\). With base TU, the height from W is RW; hence \([WTU]=\tfrac12(26)(3\sqrt{13})=39\sqrt{13}\). The right triangle GRS has area \(\tfrac12(2\sqrt{13})(3\sqrt{13})=39\). Thus the ratio is \(\sqrt{13}:1\ne7:2\); disagree.

\(L:\sqrt3x-y-2=0\). \(P\) is equidistant from \(L\) and the \(x\)-axis.
(a) Describe the geometric relation between its locus and the two lines.
(b) Find both equations in surd form.
questions.stemZh:
\(L:\sqrt3x-y-2=0\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(L\) 及 \(x\) 軸等距。
(a) 描述軌跡與兩直線的幾何關係。

questions.hint: Equate distances to two lines, remove absolute value with ±.

questions.solution:
(a) The locus is the pair of angle bisectors.
(b) \(|\sqrt3x-y-2|/2=|y|\), hence \(\sqrt3x-y-2=\pm2y\). The equations are \(\sqrt3x-3y-2=0\) and \(\sqrt3x+y-2=0\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 軌跡為兩直線所成角的兩條角平分線。
(b) \(\frac{|\sqrt3x-y-2|}{2}=|y|\)，故 \(\sqrt3x-y-2=\pm2y\)。兩式為 \(\sqrt3x-3y-2=0\) 及 \(\sqrt3x+y-2=0\)。

\(L_1:x-2y+10=0\) and \(L_2:x-2y-2=0\). \(P\) is equidistant from them; call its locus \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find \(\Gamma\).
(b) \(\Gamma\) meets the \(y\)-axis at \(A\) and \(L_2\) meets the \(x\)-axis at \(B\). Find the least area, in terms of \(\pi\), of a circle through \(A,B\).
questions.stemZh:
\(L_1:x-2y+10=0\)、\(L_2:x-2y-2=0\)。\(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。

(b) The inclination \(\theta\) of \(L\) satisfies \(\tan\theta=8/15\). (i) Find \(P\). (ii) Find \(L\).
(c) The circle moves along \(L\) on its original side, remaining tangent. (i) Find the locus of its centre. (ii) When \(P\) is the contact point, find the centre.
questions.stemZh:
\(C:x^2+y^2-32x=0\) 的圓心 \(A\) 在 \(x\) 軸上。切線 \(L\) 在 \(x\) 軸下方的 \(T\) 接觸圓，與圓右方的正 \(x\) 軸交於 \(P\)。
(a) 求 \(A\) 及半徑。
(b) \(L\) 的傾角 \(\theta\) 滿足 \(\tan\theta=8/15\)。(i) 求 \(P\)。(ii) 求 \(L\)。
(c) 圓在原來的一側沿 \(L\) 移動並保持相切。(i) 求圓心軌跡。(ii) 當 \(P\) 為接觸點時，求圓心。
questions.hint: Distance condition. Unit normal vector. Move 16 units.
questions.hintZh: 距離條件。單位法向量。移 16 單位。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(16,0),r=16\).
(b) Write \(L:8x-15y-8p=0\) with \(P=(p,0)\). The distance condition \(|128-8p|/17=16\) gives \(p=50\) or \(-18\). The stated position selects \(P=(50,0)\) and \(L:8x-15y-400=0\).
(c)(i) The same-side centre has \(8x-15y-400=-272\), hence \(8x-15y-128=0\).
(ii) Move \(16\) units from \(P\) in the original-side unit normal \((-8,15)/17\). The centre is \((722/17,240/17)\).

(b) The circle \(C\) has equation \(x^2+y^2-6x-8y+9=0\).
(i) Find the centre \(G\) and radius \(r\) of \(C\).
(ii) Show that \(\Gamma\) is tangent to \(C\) and find the point of tangency.
questions.stemZh:

(a) 求 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) \(C:x^2+y^2-6x-8y+9=0\)。(i) 求圓心 \(G\) 及半徑。(ii) 證明 \(\Gamma\) 與圓相切，並求切點。

questions.solution:
(a) \(\Gamma:3x+4y-5=0\).
(b)(i) \(G=(3,4),r=4\).
(ii) The centre-line distance is \(|9+16-5|/5=4\), equal to the radius. The perpendicular foot is \(G-(20/25)(3,4)=(3/5,4/5)\), the tangency point.

questions.stem:
The straight lines \(L_1: x+y-8=0\) and \(L_2: x-y=0\) intersect at point \(A\).
(a) Find the coordinates of \(A\).
(b) \(P\) is a moving point equidistant from \(L_1\) and \(L_2\). The locus of \(P\) consists of two straight lines \(\Gamma_1\) and \(\Gamma_2\). Find their equations.
(c) The circle \(C\) has equation \(x^2+y^2-6x-8y+k=0\), where \(k\) is a constant.
(i) Find the centre \(G\) and radius \(r\) of \(C\) in terms of \(k\), and state the condition on \(k\).
(ii) It is given that \(G\) lies on \(\Gamma_1\). If \(C\) is tangent to \(\Gamma_2\), find \(k\).
questions.stemZh:
\(L_1:x+y-8=0,L_2:x-y=0\)，交於 \(A\)。
(a) 求 \(A\)。
(b) \(P\) 與兩線等距，軌跡為 \(\Gamma_1,\Gamma_2\)。求其方程。
(c) \(C:x^2+y^2-6x-8y+k=0\)。(i) 以 \(k\) 表示圓心和半徑，並寫出 \(k\) 的條件。(ii) 圓心在 \(\Gamma_1\) 上；若圓與 \(\Gamma_2\) 相切，求 \(k\)。
questions.hint: Equate distances, absolute value gives two lines.
questions.hintZh: 等距，絕對值得兩線。
questions.solution:
(a) \(A=(4,4)\).
(b) \(|x+y-8|=|x-y|\) gives \(y=4\) or \(x=4\).
(c)(i) \(G=(3,4),r=\sqrt{25-k}\) and \(k<25\) for a non-degenerate real circle.
(ii) Label \(\Gamma_1:y=4\), \(\Gamma_2:x=4\). The distance to \(\Gamma_2\) is \(1\), so \(25-k=1\), giving \(k=24\).

questions.stem:
13. It is given that \(A\) and \(B\) are distinct points in a rectangular coordinate plane. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A B=2 B P\).
(a) Describe the locus of \(P\).
(b) Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Let \(C\) be the point of intersection of \(\Gamma\) and \(A B\). Suppose that the coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((3,5)\) and \((11,5)\) respectively. Find
(i) the equation of \(\Gamma\),
(ii) the maximum area of \(\triangle A B P\),
(iii) the area of the region bounded by \(\Gamma, B C\) and \(B P\) when \(\angle A P B=90^{\circ}\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 已知 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 為直角坐標平面上的兩個不同定點。動點 \(P\) 在直角坐標平面上移動，並滿足 \(AB=2BP\)。
(a) 描述 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(b) 以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。設 \(C\) 為 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的交點。若 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((3,5)\) 和 \((11,5)\)，求：
(i) \(\Gamma\) 的方程；
(ii) \(\triangle ABP\) 的最大面積；
(iii) 當 \(\angle APB=90^\circ\) 時，由 \(\Gamma\)、\(BC\) 及 \(BP\) 所包圍區域的面積。
questions.hint: Circle centred at B. Max area when AB⊥BP. Sector area = πr²×θ/360.
questions.hintZh: 以 B 為心圓。AB⊥BP 面積最大。扇形 = πr²×θ/360。
questions.solution:
13.(a) & The locus of \(P\) is a circle with centre \(B\). 
(b)(i) & The equation of \(\Gamma\) :

\[
\begin{aligned}
& (x-11)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}=\left(\frac{11-3}{2}\right)^{2} \\
& (x-11)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}=16
\end{aligned}
\]

(ii) & 
Area of \(\triangle A B P\) is maximum when \(A B \perp B P\). 
Required area

\[
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{2} A B \cdot B P \\
& =\frac{1}{2}(11-3)(4) \\
& =16
\end{aligned}
\]

(iii) & The region is a sector.

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \begin{aligned}
\angle A B P & =\cos ^{-1} \frac{B P}{A B} \\
& =\cos ^{-1} \frac{4}{8} \\
& =60^{\circ}
\end{aligned} \\
& \text { Required area } \\
& =\pi(B P)^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\pi \cdot 4^{2} \cdot \frac{60^{\circ}}{360^{\circ}} \\
& =\frac{8 \pi}{3} \approx 8.38
\end{aligned}
\]
questions.solutionZh:
答案：
(a) \(P\) 的軌跡為以 \(B\) 為圓心、半徑 \(\frac{AB}{2}\) 的圓。
(b)(i) \(\Gamma:(x-11)^2+(y-5)^2=16\)。
(ii) 當 \(AB\perp BP\) 時面積最大，最大面積為 \(\frac12(8)(4)=16\)。
(iii) \(\angle ABP=60^\circ\)，所求扇形面積為 \(\pi(4)^2\frac{60}{360}=\frac{8\pi}{3}\approx8.38\)。
